info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Preapprovals-v3-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Preapproval API provides an efficient means for users to access information regarding mortgage loan preapprovals. This endpoint allows consumers, such as loan officers or mortgage brokers, to retrieve a list of preapproved mortgage loans, enabling them to better serve potential homebuyers. By leveraging this API, users can quickly obtain relevant data about available preapproved loans, facilitating informed decision-making in the mortgage application process. This API is essential for improving the speed and accuracy of mortgage lending operations.

get.summary: Retrieve pre-approval status for a loan
get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the pre-approval status of their loan application. It provides necessary information to determine eligibility and readiness for loan processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a preapproval process for loans. It should contain the necessary attributes that define the request details including personal and financial information required for assessment.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the preapproval operation in the Loans service when performing a GET request. It is expected to be a JSON formatted string.

status.description: Indicates whether the preapproval request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number for the preapproval request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the preapproval request.

state.description: The current state of the preapproval request.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the preapproval request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing further information about the preapproval request.

audit.description: Detailed audit information regarding the preapproval request.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsResponse_20.description: Response schema for the GET preapproval operation, indicating the status and details of the operation.

createdBy.description: Identifier for the user who created the preapproval request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the preapproval request was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the preapproval request was generated automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information for the preapproval request.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value helps to assess the performance of the API.
